### All-in-One: Intelligent Video Management System for Secure and Data-Driven Cities and
### Organizations

AxxonSoft is dedicated to helping cities and organizations of all sizes build secure, efficient, and
intelligent operations with Axxon One VMS — a powerful, scalable video management system. Enriched
with AI-powered advanced video analytics, Axxon One ensures seamless communication between all
system components, creating a unified, data-driven ecosystem. This enables timely and proactive
decision-making to enhance security and optimize workflows.

With intuitive and flexible solutions, Axxon One VMS streamlines operations and improves situational
awareness, giving cities and organizations complete control over their video management systems —
whether on-premises, in a hybrid environment, or in the cloud.

Enhance your security system’s decision-making capabilities and establish proactive surveillance
with the Axxon One intelligent VMS and its advanced video analytics solutions.

## OUR MISSION: ITAD for A Better Planet

### WE REDUCE: We Reduce IT’s Impact on the Planet Through IT Asset Disposition

Electronics have an effect on the planet through every step of their lifecycle—from the destruction
of ecosystems as raw materials are extracted, to the manufacturing process, through use, to when
they reach the end of their lifespan. E-waste often contains hazardous substances like lead, mercury
and brominated flame retardants. These toxic substances are released into the environment—whether
the e-waste is disposed of in a landfill or incinerated—leading to ground and air pollution and
health risks.

There is no planet B. CentricsIT is on a mission to help companies dispose of their IT hardware in a
safe, secure way that minimizes ecological impact. An ITAD company with more than 18 years of
experience in giving IT hardware new life, CentricsIT is committed to reducing the ecological
effects of IT by prioritizing reuse and championing recycling.

[Sand dune against a blue sky]

### WE REUSE: We Prepare IT Equipment for Reuse through ITAD

The greenest form of recycling is reuse, which is why an ITAD company like CentricsIT is committed
to helping companies get the most out of their equipment through refurbishment and remarketing. The
production of new electronic devices requires the extraction and processing of raw materials. These
processes emit greenhouse gases and other pollutants while also contributing to the destruction of
habitats around the world.

As an ITAD company, our services address this waste stream by prioritizing reuse of IT hardware
through our programs. These programs add value to Environmental Social Governance (ESG) initiatives
by leveraging used hardware in ways beneficial to both the environment and social programs. Our ITAD
services prepare equipment for new life, offering programs that support remarketing, buyback
programs and donation to community groups. Reuse retains the value in the equipment, sharing that
value between your company, the community and the environment.

### WE RECYCLE: We Recycle according to R2

CentricsIT is R2 certified and only works with other R2-certified recyclers and ITAD companies,
ensuring environmental, quality, health and safety, and data security standards. When IT hardware
reaches not just EOL but the final end of its life, CentricsIT extracts valuable components from the
hardware and works with other recyclers to recover as much as possible throughout the ITAD process.

The R2, or Responsible Recycling certification, is adopted by organizations that process used
electronics, including ITAD companies. It is accredited by the [EPA][91] and housed by [SERI][92], a
non-profit organization that works to minimize environmental and health risks related to e-waste
while maximizing its value. It sets the standard as the most [widely adopted standard for used
electronics worldwide][93] and requires annual auditing to ensure quality and compliance.

## OUR MISSION: ITAD for A Better Planet

### WE REDUCE: We Reduce IT’s Impact on the Planet Through IT Asset Disposition

Electronics have an effect on the planet through every step of their lifecycle—from the destruction
of ecosystems as raw materials are extracted, to the manufacturing process, through use, to when
they reach the end of their lifespan. E-waste often contains hazardous substances like lead, mercury
and brominated flame retardants. These toxic substances are released into the environment—whether
the e-waste is disposed of in a landfill or incinerated—leading to ground and air pollution and
health risks.

There is no planet B. CentricsIT is on a mission to help companies dispose of their IT hardware in a
safe, secure way that minimizes ecological impact. An ITAD company with more than 18 years of
experience in giving IT hardware new life, CentricsIT is committed to reducing the ecological
effects of IT by prioritizing reuse and championing recycling.

[Sand dune against a blue sky]

### WE REUSE: We Prepare IT Equipment for Reuse through ITAD

The greenest form of recycling is reuse, which is why an ITAD company like CentricsIT is committed
to helping companies get the most out of their equipment through refurbishment and remarketing. The
production of new electronic devices requires the extraction and processing of raw materials. These
processes emit greenhouse gases and other pollutants while also contributing to the destruction of
habitats around the world.

As an ITAD company, our services address this waste stream by prioritizing reuse of IT hardware
through our programs. These programs add value to Environmental Social Governance (ESG) initiatives
by leveraging used hardware in ways beneficial to both the environment and social programs. Our ITAD
services prepare equipment for new life, offering programs that support remarketing, buyback
programs and donation to community groups. Reuse retains the value in the equipment, sharing that
value between your company, the community and the environment.

### WE RECYCLE: We Recycle according to R2

CentricsIT is R2 certified and only works with other R2-certified recyclers and ITAD companies,
ensuring environmental, quality, health and safety, and data security standards. When IT hardware
reaches not just EOL but the final end of its life, CentricsIT extracts valuable components from the
hardware and works with other recyclers to recover as much as possible throughout the ITAD process.

The R2, or Responsible Recycling certification, is adopted by organizations that process used
electronics, including ITAD companies. It is accredited by the [EPA][91] and housed by [SERI][92], a
non-profit organization that works to minimize environmental and health risks related to e-waste
while maximizing its value. It sets the standard as the most [widely adopted standard for used
electronics worldwide][93] and requires annual auditing to ensure quality and compliance.

# Your Plan, Your Dream, Your Future. Your Wealth Management Team.

[ Our Locations ][70]
[ Our Process ][71]

## About Us

In a precision timepiece, a mainspring is used to drive the entire mechanism. As the mainspring’s
energy is steadily released, each part of the timepiece is kept in continuous, precise motion. In
the same way, Mainspring Wealth Advisors acts as a driving force to keep the personal and financial
goals of our clients moving forward. You can be confident that the team at Mainspring is always at
work – like the unseen mainspring of a fine timepiece – helping to ensure that each financial
component of your life is kept in harmonious motion with the others. 

[ Meet the Team ][72]
[ Our Process ][73]

## Building A Financial Plan

In order to pursue your personal and financial goals, the many financial components of your life
must work together in harmony. This requires comprehensive planning and a detailed process to pull
it all together. You can learn about our process here.

1
Initial Consultation
Identify and clarify your goals, dreams, special concerns, and challenges.
2
Develop + Finalize Plan
Facilitate conversation around topics such as retirement planning, college savings, life insurance,
investment planning, tax strategies, estate planning, and charitable planning.
3
Execution + Implementation
Create action item list to include recommendations with appropriate schedule for implementation and
accountability.
4
Advancement Planning
Conduct reviews and consultations with outside experts, when appropriate.

## Our Services

Managing Wealth For A Wide Range Of Needs And Goals

Financial Planning

Your financial plan connects all the components of a comprehensive wealth management plan, including
investments, risk management, tax strategies, and estate planning strategies, acting as a roadmap to
help ensure your long-term goals are met.

Investment Management

We believe investing is a means to an end, and it all starts with your financial plan. We believe a
personalized financial plan is a prerequisite to a successful investing experience.

Estate and Legacy Planning

Build a holistic plan for your legacy that provides for loved ones and protects your estate.

Tax Planning

A proactive approach to tax planning helps you better understand what your tax situation may look
like in the future and how the decisions you make today can affect your future wealth.

Insurance and Asset Protection

One of the most important functions we serve is helping to protect all you have worked to build.

## Who We Serve

We serve many different clients with a variety of financial planning needs. Like them, your needs
are as individual as you are. As such, our team is proud – and pleased – to provide you with
professional guidance and an array of financial planning and wealth management services that can be
personalized to fit your situation.

### [ Individuals + Families ][74]

We work to allow clients to live their lives with a purpose and a freedom to focus on their family
and goals.

[ Learn More ][75]

### [ Business Owners ][76]

We partner with business owners to help ensure the stewardship of their legacies.

[ Learn More ][77]

### [ Pre-retirees ][78]

If you are one of the many Americans who plan to retire in the next five to 10 years, it’s time to
determine what shape your retirement savings are in.

[ Learn More ][79]

## Your Trusted Advisors

# Your Plan, Your Dream, Your Future. Your Wealth Management Team.

[ Our Locations ][70]
[ Our Process ][71]

## About Us

In a precision timepiece, a mainspring is used to drive the entire mechanism. As the mainspring’s
energy is steadily released, each part of the timepiece is kept in continuous, precise motion. In
the same way, Mainspring Wealth Advisors acts as a driving force to keep the personal and financial
goals of our clients moving forward. You can be confident that the team at Mainspring is always at
work – like the unseen mainspring of a fine timepiece – helping to ensure that each financial
component of your life is kept in harmonious motion with the others. 

[ Meet the Team ][72]
[ Our Process ][73]

## Building A Financial Plan

In order to pursue your personal and financial goals, the many financial components of your life
must work together in harmony. This requires comprehensive planning and a detailed process to pull
it all together. You can learn about our process here.

1
Initial Consultation
Identify and clarify your goals, dreams, special concerns, and challenges.
2
Develop + Finalize Plan
Facilitate conversation around topics such as retirement planning, college savings, life insurance,
investment planning, tax strategies, estate planning, and charitable planning.
3
Execution + Implementation
Create action item list to include recommendations with appropriate schedule for implementation and
accountability.
4
Advancement Planning
Conduct reviews and consultations with outside experts, when appropriate.

## Our Services

Managing Wealth For A Wide Range Of Needs And Goals

Financial Planning

Your financial plan connects all the components of a comprehensive wealth management plan, including
investments, risk management, tax strategies, and estate planning strategies, acting as a roadmap to
help ensure your long-term goals are met.

Investment Management

We believe investing is a means to an end, and it all starts with your financial plan. We believe a
personalized financial plan is a prerequisite to a successful investing experience.

Estate and Legacy Planning

Build a holistic plan for your legacy that provides for loved ones and protects your estate.

Tax Planning

A proactive approach to tax planning helps you better understand what your tax situation may look
like in the future and how the decisions you make today can affect your future wealth.

Insurance and Asset Protection

One of the most important functions we serve is helping to protect all you have worked to build.

## Who We Serve

We serve many different clients with a variety of financial planning needs. Like them, your needs
are as individual as you are. As such, our team is proud – and pleased – to provide you with
professional guidance and an array of financial planning and wealth management services that can be
personalized to fit your situation.

### [ Individuals + Families ][74]

We work to allow clients to live their lives with a purpose and a freedom to focus on their family
and goals.

[ Learn More ][75]

### [ Business Owners ][76]

We partner with business owners to help ensure the stewardship of their legacies.

[ Learn More ][77]

### [ Pre-retirees ][78]

If you are one of the many Americans who plan to retire in the next five to 10 years, it’s time to
determine what shape your retirement savings are in.

[ Learn More ][79]

SureCharge
EV Charging Operations & Maintenance Service
SureCharge is an EV charging Operations & Maintenance (O&M) service that provides intelligent
monitoring, 24/7 customer and driver support, remote troubleshooting, and managed field repairs.
[
Get Started
][1]
[
Our Services
][2]
The Reality of Public EV Charging
**Inconsistent functional reliability** directly translates to **low charger utilization and lost
revenue**, preventing site owners from achieving optimal financial returns on their EV charging
investment.
92-99%
Reported Uptime
Often misleading, as it doesn't reflect actual functionality for drivers.
71%
First-Time Charge Success
Less than three-quarters of charging attempts are successful on the first try.
20%
Drivers Can't Charge
A significant percentage of EV owners encounter charging failures.
85%
New Charger Success Rate
Initial success rate for new charging infrastructure.
<70%
Aged Charger Success Rate
Success drops significantly after 3+ years of operation, highlighting infrastructure aging.
SureCharge directly addresses these industry-wide challenges by providing proactive monitoring,
expert support, and efficient field repairs to ensure that charging stations are not just "online"
but truly functional and reliable for every EV driver.
[The SureCharge Service][3]
Analytics
* **24/7 Remote Monitoring:** Constant, round-the-clock monitoring of charger and network
  operations.
* **Proactive Maintenance:** Remote troubleshooting, diagnostics, and issue resolution at the
  software and firmware level.
* **Software and Firmware Management:** Seamless remote upgrades and patches to ensure your chargers
  are always running the latest, most stable applications.
Driver Experience
* **24/7 Support Center:** Dedicated call center and multi-modal ticketing system for immediate
  driver assistance.
* **Payment and Session Resolution:** Efficient resolution of payment failures, session errors, and
  charging disputes.
* **Seamless Charging Journey:** Comprehensive support for both public and fleet drivers to ensure a
  friction-free charging experience.
Operations
* **Uptime Optimization:** Proactive management and maintenance protocols focused on maximizing
  charger reliability and availability.
* **Revenue Generation Tools:** Implementation of dynamic pricing models and advertising
  opportunities to boost site profitability.
* **Network Interoperability:** Seamless integration with major third-party charging networks and
  customized performance reporting.
Contractor Network
* **Nationwide Vetted Professionals:** Access to a broad network of local, certified electrical
  contractors and EVITP specialists.
* **Expert On-Site Services:** Rapid dispatch for on-site troubleshooting, complex repairs, and
  essential routing and preventive maintenance.
* **Manufacturer Trained:** Technicians with specialized training from charger manufacturers to
  ensure correct and efficient hardware servicing.
Service Features
Through our nationwide network of certified electrical contractors and EVITP technicians, we deliver
local repairs, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance with manufacturer-trained technicians on
call, supported by analytics, SLA tracking, and reporting to maximize uptime and streamline
operations.
**24/7 Monitoring **
**Help Desk & Driver Support **
**Field Technicians**
**Reporting & Analytics**
Inventory & Parts
IT Services
Who We Serve
Our platform delivers mission-critical O&M services to organizations managing EV charging
infrastructure across diverse applications and scales.
Fleet Operators
Keep your electric fleet operational with 24/7 monitoring and rapid response maintenance. Minimize
vehicle downtime through proactive charging infrastructure management and predictive maintenance
protocols.
Property Owners
Enhance property value and tenant satisfaction with reliable charging amenities. We manage
everything from routine maintenance to emergency repairs, ensuring consistent uptime for workplace
and commercial charging stations.
Multifamily Properties
Deliver seamless charging experiences for residents with comprehensive maintenance programs. Our
services include tenant support, billing coordination, and preventive maintenance to maximize
resident satisfaction and system longevity.
Municipal Networks
Support your community's EV adoption goals with dependable public charging infrastructure. We
provide the operational expertise and technical resources cities need to maintain accessible,
high-performing charging networks.
Public Charging Networks
Scale your charging operations efficiently with comprehensive O&M support. From multi-site
monitoring to standardized maintenance protocols, we help network operators deliver consistent
service quality across every location.
Site Owners
Maximize revenue potential from your charging assets while minimizing operational burden. Our
turnkey O&M solutions handle technical management, allowing you to focus on your core business
operations.

SIGURNOST NA PRVOM MESTU

## Šta mi radimo

Naša stručnost obuhvata prodaju, održavanje i servisiranje industrijskih kompresora, osiguravajući
dugotrajnost i efikasnost vaše opreme.

ŠIROK ASORTIMAN

## Proizvodi u ponudi

Nudimo širok asortiman kompresora za vazduh i gas, prilagođenih različitim industrijskim potrebama.

[Pogledaj sve][11]
[Image]

## Kompresori za vazduh

Kompresori za vazduh obezbeđuju pouzdano snabdevanje komprimovanim vazduhom za različite
industrijske i zanatske primene.

## Ko smo mi?

Preduzeće BOMIX na tržištu Republike Srbije, nastupa od 1995. godine na održavanju industrijske
rotacione opreme u koju spadaju industrijski kompresori i pumpe. Naša kompanija raspolaže sa veoma
stručnim kadrom i možemo Vam ponuditi kvalitetnu uslugu servisa industrijske rotacione opreme.

Pored pružanja usluge održavanja, već dugi niz godina, uspešno vršimo prodaju vijčanih kompresora za
vazduh i klipnih kompresora za gasove.

Poslujemo na tržištu:
Republike Srbije
Crne Gore
Bosne i Hercegovine
Severne Makedonije
KAKO DO ISPRAVNE MAŠINE

## Servis i održavanje

Sve procedure prilikom servisa i održavanja su propisane od strane proizvodača predmetnih mašina a i
usaglašene su sa standardom ISO 9001:2014. Svakom servisu ili remontu pristupamo detaljno i
pažljivo.

[Detaljnije][12]
Preventivno održavanje

Pre defektaže, vršimo detaljan pregled mašine kako bismo identifikovali uzroke kvarova ili
nepravilnosti u radu.

Servis

Uz dugogodišnje iskustvo kao i direktne preporuke proizvođača opreme, svi naši servisi se izvršavaju
detaljno uz potrebnu tehničku dokumentaciju.

Laserska saosnost osovina i/ili remenica

Laserska saosnost je jedan od glavnih preduslova za normalan start mašine kao i njen dugotrajan i
pravilan rad.

SIGURNOST NA PRVOM MESTU

## Šta mi radimo

Naša stručnost obuhvata prodaju, održavanje i servisiranje industrijskih kompresora, osiguravajući
dugotrajnost i efikasnost vaše opreme.

ŠIROK ASORTIMAN

## Proizvodi u ponudi

Nudimo širok asortiman kompresora za vazduh i gas, prilagođenih različitim industrijskim potrebama.

[Pogledaj sve][11]
[Image]

## Kompresori za vazduh

Kompresori za vazduh obezbeđuju pouzdano snabdevanje komprimovanim vazduhom za različite
industrijske i zanatske primene.

## Kompresori za gas

za stacionarnu ili mobilnu upotrebu.

NEŠTO O NAMA

## Ko smo mi?

Preduzeće BOMIX na tržištu Republike Srbije, nastupa od 1995. godine na održavanju industrijske
rotacione opreme u koju spadaju industrijski kompresori i pumpe. Naša kompanija raspolaže sa veoma
stručnim kadrom i možemo Vam ponuditi kvalitetnu uslugu servisa industrijske rotacione opreme.

Pored pružanja usluge održavanja, već dugi niz godina, uspešno vršimo prodaju vijčanih kompresora za
vazduh i klipnih kompresora za gasove.

Poslujemo na tržištu:
Republike Srbije
Crne Gore
Bosne i Hercegovine
Severne Makedonije
KAKO DO ISPRAVNE MAŠINE

## Servis i održavanje

Sve procedure prilikom servisa i održavanja su propisane od strane proizvodača predmetnih mašina a i
usaglašene su sa standardom ISO 9001:2014. Svakom servisu ili remontu pristupamo detaljno i
pažljivo.

[Detaljnije][12]
Preventivno održavanje

Pre defektaže, vršimo detaljan pregled mašine kako bismo identifikovali uzroke kvarova ili
nepravilnosti u radu.

Servis

Uz dugogodišnje iskustvo kao i direktne preporuke proizvođača opreme, svi naši servisi se izvršavaju
detaljno uz potrebnu tehničku dokumentaciju.

Laserska saosnost osovina i/ili remenica

Laserska saosnost je jedan od glavnih preduslova za normalan start mašine kao i njen dugotrajan i
pravilan rad.

Kontrola vibracija i termovizijsko snimanje

Vibrodijagnostika i termovizijsko snimanje ležajeva mašine je ozbiljna preventivna radnja koja nam
govori u kakvom je stanju mašina, odnosno da li postoje problemi u radu.

Pravilno centriranje mašina ne samo da smanjuje habanje i produžava njihov radni vek, već i značajno
smanjuje rizik od neplaniranih zastoja, čime se povećava efikasnost i smanjuju troškovi održavanja.

QR code
[QR code scanner]

Fabrico CMMS takes maintenance management to the next level with its integrated QR code scanner
feature for machines and spare parts. This tool enhances the efficiency of tracing maintenance
activities and spare parts management, ensuring that information is accurate and easily accessible. 

QR codes serve as a quick and efficient method for recording and retrieving data related to
maintenance tasks. Each machine and spare part can be tagged with a unique QR code, which, when
scanned, provides instant access to detailed information such as maintenance history, usage
statistics, and part specifications. This eliminates the need for manual data entry, reducing the
risk of errors and saving valuable time. 

[Learn more about QR code scanner][65]
[QR code scanner]
Machine connectivity
[Machine connectivity]

Fabrico connects any machine — new or legacy — using PLCs, IoT sensors, or cameras powered by AI.
Our modular connectivity approach ensures no production line is left behind.

 

**1. Existing Machine Connectivity (PLCs)**

For machines that already have connectivity

**2. IoT Device with External Sensors**

For machines with limited connectivity

**3. Production Output through Camera/AI**

For cases where sensors can’t collect data

QR code
[QR code scanner]

Fabrico CMMS takes maintenance management to the next level with its integrated QR code scanner
feature for machines and spare parts. This tool enhances the efficiency of tracing maintenance
activities and spare parts management, ensuring that information is accurate and easily accessible. 

QR codes serve as a quick and efficient method for recording and retrieving data related to
maintenance tasks. Each machine and spare part can be tagged with a unique QR code, which, when
scanned, provides instant access to detailed information such as maintenance history, usage
statistics, and part specifications. This eliminates the need for manual data entry, reducing the
risk of errors and saving valuable time. 

[Learn more about QR code scanner][65]

— deeply integrated capabilities that replace spreadsheet chaos and legacy CMMS tools with one
platform your technicians will actually use. See the results in our [maintenance case studies][17].

Create, assign, and track work orders with automated routing, SLA timers, and full audit trails —
from request to resolution.

### Preventive Maintenance

Schedule recurring maintenance by time, usage, or condition triggers. Never miss a PM window with
automated escalations.

### Command Center Dashboard

One live dashboard for everything — asset uptime, open work orders, MTTR, MTBF, and PM compliance —
with board-ready reports in one click.

### Inventory & Parts

Track spare parts across warehouses with min/max reorder points, barcode scanning, and automatic
purchase requisitions.

### Easy to Roll Out

Go live in days, not months. Guided data migration, templated workflows, and zero-training mobile UX
mean adoption without the IT project.

### Scalable by Design

Start with one site and grow to hundreds. Unlimited assets, multi-site hierarchies, and role-based
access that scales with your organization.

### Mobile-First Field App

Technicians get offline-capable mobile access to work orders, manuals, and checklists — right at the
asset, even without signal.

power draw — plus an ideal charge time from charger power.

rack positions needed and approximate floor area.

run-hours per year, and an optional maintenance allowance.

Convert a ramp's rise and run (or a grade %) into a grade percentage and incline angle, and check it
against a typical forklift gradeability limit.

## Enhancing Customer Experiences.

## Simplifying Field Service Delivery

## How can ReachOut help you drive field service business
* [ Centralized CRM][59]

### Centralized CRM

Manage all your customer data in one place without the risk of data loss. Enable your technicians to
provide the best customer service with a clear view of customer queries, pending tasks, and ongoing
work.

### Built-In Inventory System

Lets you quickly access your complete inventory data, easily manage returns and allocations to field
agents, track inventory logs, thereby enabling efficient management of inventory and costs.

### Mobile Field Service App

Empowers field technicians to work effectively with instant notifications on jobs assigned,
optimized route options to job locations, easy access to checklists, quick quotes and invoice
generation, and easy capturing of field data even when offline.

### Customer Portal

Your customers can easily log in to the self-service hub and submit service requests directly,
whereas admins can oversee and manage the new service requests initiated by customers.

### Route Optimization

Get your technicians faster to job locations with the shortest and most cost-effective route
options. Replan finalized routes when there are changes in the schedule and save routes for future
use.

### Checklists

Let your field technicians go completely paperless on the field with standard and styled checklists.
Quickly collect field data on phone/tablet to avoid errors and complete tasks on time.

### Quoting & Estimation

Create quotes and estimates covering service costs quickly and share them instantly with customers
via emails. Convert approved quotes to work orders or inspections with just a click.

### Job Creation & Scheduling

Create jobs with the task details, attachments, estimates, instructions to field agents, and more.
Schedule jobs easily with our intuitive drag-and-drop scheduler.

### Accounting Integrations

Link third-party accounting tools, like Quickbooks and Xero, to monitor and review transactions
easily. Rapidly sync customer data, invoices, and payments to manage and track real-time cash flows.

## Field Service Software to Empower Your Teams

* Manual scheduling

* Zero inventory control
* Delayed invoicing

* Organize jobs. Optimize routes.

Both Snipe-IT as a software product and our cloud-hosting infrastructure were designed with security

Snipe-IT is improved constantly, with new releases every few weeks. Bug-fixes and new features ship

# [2025 Annual Meeting Minutes][66]

[December 12, 2025][67] [Jim Buie][68]

President Steve Krasnow called the meeting to order at 10:04 a.m. Directors Ernie Clarke, Bob
Spillane, and John Bailey were in attendance, joined by Treasurer Rebecca Newton, Secretary Maria
Tanner, Communications Chair Joyce Brennan, and Millhouse Properties (MHP) representative
Michelle Johnson.

A quorum of homeowners was reached by those in attendance and proxies cast.

President Krasnow welcomed homeowners and introduced the Board members and Mill House
representative. He highlighted the projects undertaken this year. For the details on these projects,
please see the introduction provided in the Annual General Meeting packet that was sent to
homeowners prior to the meeting.

Committee Reports
(Note: The Annual Committee Reports that provide a summary of each committee’s targeted work
throughout the year were sent to homeowners for review in the AGM packet prior to the meeting. In
this meeting each Committee Chair focused on specific or additional issues of importance.)

• Architectural Control – Bob Spillane, Chair
1. Approved upgrades to some units, including porches.
2. A “walk-around” was conducted to determine how easy it was to traverse from the back to the
front of each unit in case of an emergency, especially during weather and fire situations requiring
emergency exits. He encouraged everyone to check whether they would safely be able to move outside
from the back to the front of their unit as well and report any problems to Mill House Properties.

• Building and Street Maintenance – Ernie Clarke, Chair
1. The procedure to resolve problems is to contact Mill House Properties who create work orders
under the direction of Director Clarke and the committee for completion.
2. The preferred contractors are JCnJC Home Improvement, Chief Roofing, Brafford Renovations, and
Open Door Policy
3. Major infrastructure tasks are paid out of the reserves and day-to-day tasks are paid out of the
operating budget.

• Communications – Joyce Brennan, Chair
1. Purpose is to provide timely information to homeowners and residents and to welcome newcomers to
